job_description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Backend Engineer to join our growing engineering team. You will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable microservices architecture, mentoring junior developers, and driving technical decisions.

Responsibilities:
- Design and develop RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI
- Build and maintain microservices architecture
- Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated testing
- Lead code reviews and establish best practices
- Collaborate with product and frontend teams
- Optimize database queries and system performance
- Mentor junior engineers and conduct technical interviews

Qualifications:
- 5+ years of backend development experience
- Strong expertise in Python and modern frameworks
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
- Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases
- Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
- Experience with distributed systems and microservices
- Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for professional growth.
